newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble o/n rates firm as funds shifted in T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Rouble o/n rates firm as funds shifted in T-bills.

text.p: Overnight rouble credit rates firmed on Wednesday as banks sought roubles to participate in today's Treasury bill sales, dealers said.
The Russian Finance Ministry is auctioning six trillion roubles in 364-day Treasury bills (series 23004) and four trillion roubles of an additional tranche of 119-day T-bills (series 22073).
roubles/dollar Apr 9 midday Apr 9 early Apr 8 close
"Today's auctions are interesting and banks may be seeking roubles to invest in T-bills tomorrow (in secondary trading)," Bank Vozrozhdenye dealer Alexei Vorobyov said.
TOKObank dealer Alexei Golovenko said the relative rouble shortage could be also due to Tuesday's rouble buying by banks ahead of the auctions.
